about.heading: From Physics to Production AI
paragraphs: I work directly with founders and small teams who'd rather have one person own the whole build than coordinate across an agency, design, backend, AI, deployment, all under one roof.
Over the past 4+ years I've shipped chatbots, automation pipelines, SaaS platforms, and multi-agent systems for more than 100 clients across healthcare, real estate, e-commerce, and finance.

My background is in Computational Physics, which is where the habit of not settling for the standard solution came from. That instinct led to a published paper on Quantum ML (arXiv) comparing LSTM and QLSTM for stock market prediction.
I also lean on modern AI tooling day to day, Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, which is part of how one person can reasonably cover this much ground.
highlights: 40 to 70% average cost reduction for clients
Published researcher on arXiv (LSTM vs. QLSTM)
23K+ followers in the AI community on LinkedIn
